settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: FQDN under which AiiDAlab is published through Traefik.
settings.password_placeholder: leave empty to keep the current password
settings.password_helper: Password of the AiiDAlab web interface (single-user workspace). Required on the first configuration.
settings.identity_helper: Recorded in the provenance graph as the author of every calculation; used when the profile is created at the first start.
settings.default_apps_helper: One AiiDAlab app name (from the app registry) or git URL per line, installed at every container start if missing — e.g. aiidalab-qe (Quantum ESPRESSO app). Further apps can be installed from the App Store inside AiiDAlab.
settings.computer_helper: Register an SSH-reachable machine (e.g. your GPU node on Proxmox) as AiiDA computer: calculations are submitted there while AiiDAlab keeps the provenance. The codes (Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, xtb, …) must be installed on that machine; they are registered as AiiDA codes inside AiiDAlab.
settings.computer_hostname_helper: Machine reachable over SSH. For a target on this NethServer node itself enter host.containers.internal (a rootless container cannot reach the node's own IP). Host name, work directory and scheduler of an existing computer cannot be changed — use a new label instead.
settings.computer_workdir_helper: Absolute path on the remote machine where calculations run, e.g. /home/aiida/aiida_run.
settings.computer_mpirun_helper: {tot_num_mpiprocs} is replaced by the number of MPI processes.
settings.sshkey_title: SSH public key of this AiiDAlab instance
settings.sshkey_desc: Add this key to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of the SSH user on the remote computer, then save and run the connection test.
settings.sshkey_unavailable: The key is generated at the first start of the container.
settings.status_starting: Container running — services starting (first start: profile creation and app installation take a few minutes)
settings.web_url_desc: Open {url} and log in with the password.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Host name already used by another application
